topic: A person discovers their child has the same teacher they had
text: The path through the trees is familiar, yet today the shadows seem longer, the whispers of the wind more insistent. I move with caution, each step deliberate, testing the ground. The scent of pine needles mingles with something unfamiliar, something that makes my pace slow, my senses sharpen. The forest echoes with the distant call of a hawk, a reminder to be alert, to watch for signs. I scan the edges, my gaze flickering from one patch of underbrush to another, searching for what might be hidden. Every now and then, a twig snaps, or leaves rustle, and I freeze, my breath held, waiting. It’s a cycle, this careful tread, this constant vigilance, each moment a test of whether I belong here, whether I can keep what is precious safe.
